title: Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus (Madhumeha) — Dual-System Clinical Monograph
source: ICMR Guidelines, WHO Essential Medicines & AYUSH API
content:
Condition: Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus (Hyperglycemia / Madhumeha).
Allopathic Pharmacology: Metformin 500mg-1000mg with or after meals (First-line biguanide to decrease hepatic gluconeogenesis and improve insulin sensitivity). Glimepiride, Dapagliflozin, Sitagliptin (Rx only). Regular HbA1c and fasting blood sugar monitoring.
Ayurvedic Formulations: Nisha-Amalaki (Turmeric + Amla powder 2g twice daily) to protect microvasculature. Karela (Bitter Gourd) & Jamun Seed Churna (3g before meals). Vasant Kusumakar Rasa (classical Herbo-mineral). Gymnema sylvestre (Gudmar - 'Sugar destroyer').
Home Remedies & Lifestyle: Fenugreek (Methi) seeds soaked overnight in water (drink water and chew seeds in morning), 30 minutes daily brisk walking, Low glycemic index diet, Cinnamon powder (1/2 tsp in warm water).
Precautions: Monitor blood glucose regularly to avoid hypoglycemia when combining therapies.
